calculation: continuous natural-xenon three-body rate with AFH-7 and explicitly labelled Helm diagnostics
response_convention: AFH direct finite-sum at exact spatial q; PCHIP grid is diagnostic only; Helm fallback is separate
nuclear_mass_scheme: NIST atomic isotope mass minus 54 electron masses, converted to GeV; electron binding energy neglected
AFH_evaluation: official v6.0 density matrices parsed from source and direct finite-sum evaluation at every recoil q

AFH_PCHIP_comparison.interpretation: interpolation diagnostic only; direct exact-q values are used in the rate

Helm_model_comparison.formula: R=A^2 F_Helm(q)^2; F=3 j1(q r_n)/(q r_n) exp[-(q s)^2/2]
Helm_model_comparison.role: phenomenological fallback for Xe-124/Xe-126 and separate Helm-9 model comparison; not AFH data

scenarios.AFH-7: AFH v6.0 for seven supported isotopes; Xe-124/Xe-126 omitted; natural abundances not renormalized
scenarios.Hybrid-9 (AFH-7 + Helm-2): AFH v6.0 for seven supported isotopes and Helm for Xe-124/Xe-126
scenarios.AFH-7 + A2-2 ceiling: AFH v6.0 for seven supported isotopes and R=A^2 for Xe-124/Xe-126; diagnostic ceiling, not a nuclear model
scenarios.Helm-9: Helm response for all nine naturally occurring isotopes; separate model comparison

width.assumptions: Dirac fermions, real scalar, pure scalar off-diagonal Yukawa, only chi2 -> chi1 s open

max_speed_on_shell_exclusion.check: global analytic max over all recoil energies at the SHM maximum lab speed

not_included: AFH v6.0 Xe-124/Xe-126 density matrices; these are absent from the official default dispatch
NEST S1/S2 response, efficiency, energy resolution, exposure and LZ likelihood
annual modulation and time-dependent Earth velocity
